scope: Mocked PostgreSQL claim/finish operations and mocked ClickHouse client, including the real one-shot CLI parser; no live database or ClickHouse service.
behaviors: disabled ClickHouse provider does not claim rows or open a client
client setup exception records a failed outcome for each claimed row
enabled provider with no client records a sanitized setup failure
failed setup-outcome persistence propagates without a second finish attempt
partial batch insert failure is isolated from successful row delivery
database completion failure after insertion propagates without retrying completion
successful insert with lost completion fence counts as failed
client close failure propagates after the row outcome is recorded
one-shot CLI exits nonzero when a projection fails
one-shot CLI accepts an empty successful batch
limitations: Mocked _finish calls do not prove persisted PostgreSQL status transitions or lease expiry recovery; see the companion disposable-PostgreSQL record.
No worker process restart, ClickHouse deduplication, or long-duration behavior was exercised.
No candidate, legacy database, or Docker service was touched.
